phase: B2: Blind Threat Discovery & Confidence Calibration

blind_evaluation_scenarios.gold_hypothesis: Malicious macro/payload executed powershell.exe establishing a reverse shell, subsequently scanning subnet 192.168.1.0/24 for lateral movement.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Malicious Macro Execution with Encoded PowerShell Reverse Shell
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from execution signature of PowerShell interpreter with encoded payload on WORKSTATION-04 associated with network egress and discovery.

blind_evaluation_scenarios.gold_hypothesis: External attacker executed dictionary attack against SSH/FTP, resulting in successful unauthorized authentication.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Credential Access via Automated Password Guessing and Valid Account Abuse
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from cluster containing repeated authentication failures targeting UBUNTU-SRV-01, WORKSTATION-04 originating from external IP (13.58.225.34, 18.218.115.60).

blind_evaluation_scenarios.gold_hypothesis: Attacker exploited input validation vulnerabilities in web app, attempting SQL injection to extract backend records.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Web Application Database Exploitation via SQL Injection
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from observed HTTP application requests to WEB-SRV-01, WORKSTATION-04 carrying SQL injection primitives and database query extraction syntax.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Malicious Macro Execution with Encoded PowerShell Reverse Shell
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from execution signature of PowerShell interpreter with encoded payload on WEB-SRV-01, WORKSTATION-04 associated with network egress and discovery.

blind_evaluation_scenarios.gold_hypothesis: Internal nodes compromised by Ares botnet establishing periodic C2 beaconing connections to remote IP.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Botnet Command & Control Active Beaconing
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from periodic outbound connection flows on port 8080 from WORKSTATION-04, WORKSTATION-10 to remote infrastructure 13.58.225.34, 18.219.211.138 characteristic of C2 agent beaconing.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Malicious Macro Execution with Encoded PowerShell Reverse Shell
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from execution signature of PowerShell interpreter with encoded payload on WORKSTATION-04, WORKSTATION-10 associated with network egress and discovery.

blind_evaluation_scenarios.gold_hypothesis: Distributed nodes conducted Slowloris/GoldenEye HTTP starvation attack against port 80.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Application-Layer Denial of Service against Web Services
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from high-density HTTP connection flows exhibiting socket starvation and pool exhaustion against WEB-SRV-01, WORKSTATION-04 on port 80.

discovered_hypotheses.label: Malicious Macro Execution with Encoded PowerShell Reverse Shell
discovered_hypotheses.provenance: Generated from execution signature of PowerShell interpreter with encoded payload on WEB-SRV-01, WORKSTATION-04 associated with network egress and discovery.

limit_1.behavioral_characteristic: Premature escalation on transient sensor delay

confidence_calibration_analysis.calibration_finding: Investigations that discover confirmed matching hypotheses naturally achieve higher confidence (~0.28-0.34 in 6 cycles) than stalled/unresolved investigations (~0.15-0.20), confirming monotonic alignment.
